messages:
jess: Customer reported invoice shows ~42% higher token usage than their SDK estimator. attaching repro notes and request_id.

mike: Can you share the request_id + sample payload? :eyes:

jess: request_id=rvx-2026-03-10-09:23:17-7b9c
jess: curl they ran:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-13b","input":"Summarize quarterly results","stream":false,"functions":[{"name":"ranker","inputs":{}}]}'
```

jess: SDK estimate: 1,420 tokens. Invoice shows 2,030 tokens. They noticed extra system messages in the API response but the SDK estimator didn't include them.

lee: (Metering) we rolled a sidecar change last week that appends a JSON-encoded trace block to requests when org feature-flag `trace_append` is enabled. That block is inserted server-side as a system message after prompt processing; depending on metadata it can add ~150-300 tokens. Could explain the delta.

mike: hmm, invoices should exclude telemetry. Are those traces getting routed to the metering pipeline? :bug:

lee: initial findings: the trace block starts with a non-printable separator U+001F (we log it as `\u001fTRACE:...`). Our tokenizer counts that block as content. There's also a gateway dedupe issue: when functions are invoked server-side, the function output and the trace block are concatenated and the dedupe key doesn't account for the concat, so both fragments end up counted.

jess: repro steps from customer:
1) send same request with `stream:false` -> invoice usage shows +600 tokens.
2) toggle `trace_append=false` for the org feature-flag -> invoice usage drops and matches SDK estimate.

jess: minimal repro response excerpt attached:
```
{"id":"resp-...","choices":[{"message":{"role":"system","content":"\u001fTRACE:{\"route\":\"us-west-2\",\"host\":\"sidecar-12\"}"}},{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"Here is the summary...","tool_calls":[{"name":"ranker","output":"..."}]}}]}
```

lee: thanks. please DM the full raw response + headers (x-request-id, x-routing, x-sidecar-version) and a sample invoice line for that billing window. we'll run a replay through the metering consumer.

mike: also include sidecar logs for the request_id (/var/log/sidecar/trace.log or equivalent).

jess: uploaded logs and customer repro to internal ticket https://redwood.internal/bug/5442 :white_check_mark:

opbot: deploy-bot: rolled back trace-append flag for prod orgs at 2026-03-11T04:02:00Z

lee: audit replay confirms the trace block was being tokenized and counted. We're preparing two fixes: (1) strip U+001F-prefixed trace entries prior to tokenization in the ingest pipeline, (2) fix gateway dedupe key to include concatenated-hash so function outputs + traces dedupe correctly. We'll patch and run a backfill to adjust charges for affected orgs. ETA ~24h. :thumbsup:

jess: flagged for billing credits and told customer we'll apply a temporary credit while the fix lands.

mike: please add a short postmortem to #postmortems once the hotfix is live (include change id and test cases).

jess: follow-ups assigned: @lee to push metering patch, @mike to add ingest/gateway tests, @jess to confirm customer credit/refund. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
